name: warp
description: Browser extension for siphoning magnet, torrent, and NZB downloads to remote clients.

scripts.dev:chromium: npm run build:dev && npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 run --source-dir dist/dev/chromium --target chromium
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:dev && npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 run --source-dir dist/dev/firefox --target firefox-desktop
scripts.validate:browsers: npm run check:secrets -- --dist && node scripts/validate-release.mjs && npx --yes web-ext@10.6.0 lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:secrets -- --tracked && npm run build:release && npm run validate:browsers
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
